title: Antarctic Sea Ice Lost 1.3 Million Square Kilometers
hook: Antarctic sea ice lost 1.3 million square kilometers.
closing: Less reflective ice leaves more heat in the ocean, affecting the whole climate system.
question: Did this ice loss surprise you?

segments.say: Antarctic sea ice fell to 1.79 million square kilometers, setting a record low.
The missing Antarctic ice covered 1.3 million square kilometers, an area larger than two major states combined.
Sea ice reflects 60% of sunlight, so losing it lets the ocean absorb much more heat.
